result.title: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving
result.summary: In large language model (LLM) serving systems, the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and concurrency, so long-context inference easily hits the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity wall and results in low concurrency. Offloading the KV cache to host dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) frees HBM space and raises concurrency, but the additional cache management and host-to-device (H2D) load overhead inflates inference latency, higher concurrency fails to translate into effective throughput. We present FlashOffloading, a host-DRAM-centric inference architecture that fully offloads the KV cache in both the prefill and decode phases. FlashOffloading builds rolling HBM cache for prefill, a hot cache for decode, a reverse sparse index with zero extra miss-lookup overhead, and a compute--load overlapped kernel, optimizing KV offloading latency across the entire pipeline and delivering throughput gains under a time-per-output-token (TPOT) service-level objective (SLO). In experiments deploying GLM-5.2 with multi-token prediction (MTP3) speculative decoding on an Ascend910C prefill--decode (PD)-disaggregated platform, FlashOffloading improves prefill throughput by up to 1.38\(\times\) and decode throughput by up to 1.91\(\times\) under a 30 ms TPOT constraint. FlashOffloading is integrated into an open-source serving framework: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/tree/releases/v0.30.0.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 FlashOffloading，一套把 KV cache 全量卸载到主机 DRAM 的推理架构，通过滚动 HBM 缓存、热缓存、反向稀疏索引与计算–加载重叠内核，在 TPOT 约束下提升长上下文服务的 prefill/decode 吞吐。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是一项面向显存容量与传输延迟的系统层工程优化，其「cache」指硬件存储层级而非模型内部的 latent 推理状态，未涉及视觉证据、latent 内容的使用或推理停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可迁移线索。
